description: This file defines the AzureQueueStreamProviderBuilder class used to configure Azure Queue Storage streaming providers in Orleans. It contains methods to set up configurations for silo and client builders, and manages options like queue names, message visibility timeout, and connection details.

classes.name: AzureQueueStreamProviderBuilder
classes.description: Builder class for configuring Azure Queue streaming providers for Orleans silo and client components. Implements methods to set up queue options based on configuration sections.

methods.name: Configure
methods.description: Configures an ISiloBuilder or IClientBuilder with Azure Queue streaming settings based on a configuration section.

methods.name: GetQueueOptionBuilder
methods.description: Creates an options configuration action that sets Azure Queue options like queue names, message visibility timeout, and service client based on provided configuration section.
